messages:
rhea: Quick UX check: heatmap legend and axis in the Console are pushing the sparkline down at narrow widths. Units like `req/s` and `p99` are taking too much space. Options: compact tokens (`p99 · req/s`), stacked two-line legend, or a left collapsed axis that expands on focus.

ben: Compact tokens are the least noisy. Make tokens tappable to open full context popover (touch-friendly). Avoid hover-only affordances.

toni: Accessibility: if you compact visually, include a visually-hidden element with the full label for screen readers: e.g., "95th percentile requests per second (p95)". Ensure popover is reachable via keyboard and that focus moves into it.

sam: For smoothing, prefer a single label `Smoothing (reduce noise)` with tooltip: `Median smoothing preserves spikes better than simple averaging.` Expose per-card toggle with a global default.

rhea: Anomalies: propose `Highlight anomalies` toggle. When on show diamond markers and a small anomaly list under the chart. When off keep lines intact (no dimming) to avoid hiding data.

toni: Markers need shape + aria: e.g., "Anomaly on 2025-06-11 10:00: 120 req/s (~3.5x baseline)". Also add a link `View anomalies (table)` for SR users.

bot-preview: Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/heatmap-compact-legend (expires in 24h)

rhea: I'll mock the compact token legend + popover and post tomorrow. Thanks!
